title: STPA-Sec threat model of agent identity for MCP
description: Control structure: user, agent, MCP client, MCP server, authz, SPIRE. Unsafe control actions mapped to MCP spec 2026-07-28 clauses (token passthrough, stdio env keys, CIMD trust). Writing only. Picks the next demo scenarios.

title: Report SPIRE agent jwtSVIDIncludeJTI cache bug upstream
description: SPIRE 1.15.3 agent drops the per-entry jwtSVIDIncludeJTI setting when syncing entries (pkg/agent/client/util.go), so cached JWT-SVIDs are reused with the same jti. Prepare a minimal reproduction; filing the issue needs Tanya's approval. After a fix, switch the demo back to --svid-replay reject.

title: Test the no token passthrough invariant
description: Threat model UCA 10.5: invariant holds by design but has no test. Add a test with a server that makes an outbound call and assert it never carries the incoming token; demo variant where forwarding gets 401.

title: HTTPS and private-address checks on discovery URLs
description: Threat model UCA 3.4, 7.4, 7.6: agent discovery follows PRM and AS metadata URLs without requiring https or refusing private/link-local addresses (SSRF). Enforce https outside an explicit dev flag, block private ranges, add tests for existing discovery checks.

title: Delegation chain with Transaction Tokens
description: user -> agent -> tool: token exchange producing a Transaction Token with sub = user and act = SPIFFE ID (draft-ietf-oauth-transaction-tokens, transaction-tokens-for-agents). Demo answers which agent acted for whom. Phase 2 of the project.

title: jti replay tracking for JWT-SVID assertions
description: Track seen jti within max SVID lifetime at authz; reject replays. Currently a documented non-goal.

title: Client-side trusted issuer allowlist
description: agent_client trusts any authorization server named in PRM and mints an SVID for that audience. Add an allowlist of issuers; refuse unknown ones. Add tests.

title: Replace unix attestor with docker attestor
description: Unix attestor is UID based and weak. Move compose to the docker workload attestor with label selectors, update register.sh, rerun make demo, update README and docs security page.

title: Demo scenarios from the threat model
description: Next demos: same-UID or same-label impostor, malicious AS entry in notes-b PRM, replayed JWT-SVID at /token, notes-a calling notes-b with its own token vs forwarding, grant removal mid-run, authz restart with cached JWKS. Prompt-injected write stays documented as out of scope for identity.

title: Stop long tool calls when the token expires
description: Threat model UCA 10.8: a tool call continues after its token expires. Bound execution by token exp or re-check before side effects.

title: Refresh or remove the exported token env var
description: Threat model UCA 11.6: --export-token-env value is set once and never refreshed or removed. Either document it as single-use, or restart the child on refresh; prefer the token file.

title: Policy reload and grant revocation
description: Threat model UCA 2.4, 8.6: policy is loaded once at start, no revocation. Reload on SIGHUP or file change, deny new tokens for removed grants, document time-to-denial (max token lifetime). Demo: remove a grant mid-run and measure.

title: Hash-chained audit trail for tool calls
description: Tamper-evident audit records per tool call, aligned with draft-sharif-agent-audit-trail; verify command. Pairs with the delegation epic.

title: Filter tools/list by token scope
description: Read-only tokens currently see notes.write in tools/list. Optional hardening.

title: Async JWKS fetch with refetch on unknown kid
description: verify_token uses a sync fetch inside async code; unknown kid does not trigger refetch, so tokens fail up to 60s after authz restart. Async client, single rate-limited refetch.

title: Bump cryptography and zensical bounds when needed
description: cryptography pinned <51, zensical <0.1 (0.0.x). Revisit at next major.

title: kind variant with k8s workload attestor
description: Kubernetes demo with SPIRE k8s attestor as an alternative to compose.
